blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs survived a late rally by the University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters to escape with a 67-64 victory in their rematch as the Cesafi Season 26 men’s basketball tournament opened its second round on Saturday, October 17, at the Cebu Coliseum. Serge Gabines led the Cheetahs with a double-double of 16 points and 10 rebounds, adding four blocks and two assists. He shot 7-of-13 from the field, delivering crucial baskets when Benedicto needed them most. Den Rick Orgong chipped in 17 points, five rebounds, three assists, and a steal, while Kenneth Babalcon contributed […]...
